summary: Assassination Mutilate with Seal Fate, Cold Blood and Vile Poisons, plus Precision and Puncturing Wounds in Combat, on a synthetic dagger with a fast sword in the off hand. It is the Assassination preset; Mutilate is pinned as the builder.
rotation: Slice and Dice at 1+ combo points when down; refresh when about to drop
Cold Blood right before a 5-point Eviscerate
Thistle Tea at 10 energy or less; Sapper, Land Mine and potion while Slice and Dice is up
Eviscerate at 4+ combo points (with Slice and Dice up, 79+ energy, or under 6 s left); spend leftover points in the last 3 s
Mutilate right after a main-hand swing (0.75 s)
consumes: Deadly Poison (main hand) and Instant Poison (off hand), each beside a Dense Sharpening Stone
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 31 Agility and 15 crit rating, and 335 attack power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Backstab with the same talents is about 20 DPS ahead; Mutilate is pinned to define the spec
Venom (25 Energy) loses DPS at every combo point count, so no Venom preset
Mutilate needing only a main-hand dagger is open for beta testing
Murder is damage only (+4% vs Humanoids and Giants) and does nothing on the generic boss, so its 2 points go to Lethality (Vile Poisons for Seal Fate Daggers); the vs Humanoid build keeps Murder 2/2
Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Backstab VIII, Eviscerate VIII, Deadly Poison IV) left out under Forever; would add +13 to +18
Grimstitch 4/5-piece bonuses not live on the synthetic gear (about +8 / +6 for Combat Daggers)
Flask of Supreme Power and Greater Arcane Elixir omitted for consistency (+8 via Dragonbreath Chili)
notes: Default for the Assassination raid-sim preset.
